title: Risk-Calibrated Autonomy for Healthcare AI Agents: live-agent benchmark harness
description: Reproducibility materials for a live-agent benchmark of an independent action-safety gateway for healthcare AI agents. Contains the frozen synthetic episode generator, in-memory tool environment, Action Safety Gateway, Dynamic Autonomy Controller, condition-blinded adjudicator, agent adapters, prespecified analysis and figure code, and the invariant test suite. All episodes are synthetic; the deposit contains no patient data, no human-subjects data, and no identifiable personal information. Note: the superseded parameterized simulation (src/run_synthetic_benchmark.py) is retained for provenance only and its outputs must not be cited as measured results.
